ADV F items:inventory/any c
ADV F minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
# F is full: plain food is refused, nothing fires, not even the using_item trigger
ADV F items:inventory/any c
ADV F minecraft:adventure/adventuring_time minecraft:plains
ADV F minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 43
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 43
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 43
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 43
I F 0 minecraft:bread*2
I F 1 minecraft:golden_apple*2
USE F hand=main item=empty remaining=0 ticks=0 kinetic=0
# F eats a golden apple, always edible: consume_item for the item, the hunger predicate (food above 6) fails
ADV F items:inventory/any c
ADV F minecraft:adventure/adventuring_time minecraft:plains
ADV F minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
USE F hand=main item=minecraft:golden_apple*2 remaining=29 ticks=3 kinetic=0
ADV F items:consume/any c
ADV F items:consume/golden_apple c
ADV F items:inventory/any c
ADV F minecraft:adventure/adventuring_time minecraft:plains
ADV F minecraft:husbandry/balanced_diet golden_apple
ADV F minecraft:husbandry/root consumed_item
ADV F minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 82
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 82
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 82
STAT F minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 82
STAT F minecraft.used:minecraft.golden_apple 1
I F 0 minecraft:bread*2
I F 1 minecraft:golden_apple*1
# P is hungry and eats the stack of three apples one by one: the count conditions see 3, then 2, then 1
